beats.text: Four minutes to liquidation. You're not looking at your phone.
While you're in another app, the warning lands in Telegram.
One glance: position, distance, time. The alert fires at sixty-one thousand five hundred.
Three positions. Riskiest first: SOL, about ten minutes.
Close half. WickSight previews the exact order, sized to the position. Default is No. Swipe to Yes, then tap. Reduce-only, on Binance testnet. Nothing else changes.
The receipt shows what changed. Liquidation moves away, and the buffer nearly doubles.
The same HUD, in the Even Hub simulator.
Trade-only keys. Withdrawal keys refused. Testnet only. Explicit yes. WickSight.
